prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1464; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presented with scrape marks and a dented rear quarter panel on the passenger side, along with a cracked taillight lens and a scuffed rear bumper cover. The damage pattern lines up well with a sideswipe during a lane change, and the locations match the account given at intake. The repair plan calls for panel straightening, replacement of the taillight assembly, refinishing of the affected panels, and bumper cover repair. The labor hours requested fit the scope of the work. The invoices reviewed show no duplicated line items. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from the records available.
